payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-22 (later): the owner signed 75 sources (#3766), then chose to adopt the 73 sources the medication pages link to (71 TGA PI search records, WA Monitored Medicines Prescribing Code, ScriptCheckWA; docs/decisions/2026-10-22-adopt-medication-page-sources.md). Adoption voids those signatures. Next action: owner re-signs the adopted batch with clinical:review --pack then --write --batch, after which the links render. The older lithium, clozapine, mood-disorder and dictionary sources still need their own adoption decision.
